payload.content:
name: techvault
description: 'Operational RAES projection for the TechVault range. This SDL is the
  public startup contract: it names the steady-state services and networks that the
  full live TechVault smoke realizes without carrying the deep per-asset inventory
  encoded in examples/scenarios/techvault.sdl.yaml.

  '
nodes:
  security-net:
    type: switch
    description: SOC and security tooling network.
  dmz-net:
    type: switch
    description: TechVault DMZ network.
  internal-net:
    type: switch
    description: Internal enterprise target network.
  redteam-net:
    type: switch
    description: Red-team operations network.
  wazuh-manager:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    conditions:
      wazuh-manager-health: ''
    services:
    - port: 55000
      protocol: tcp
      name: wazuh-api
    - port: 1514
      protocol: tcp
      name: agent-events
    - port: 514
      protocol: udp
      name: syslog
  wazuh-indexer:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 9200
      protocol: tcp
      name: indexer-api
  wazuh-dashboard:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 5601
      protocol: tcp
      name: dashboard
  suricata:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services: []
  misp:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 443
      protocol: tcp
      name: https
  misp-db:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 3306
      protocol: tcp
      name: mysql
  misp-redis:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 6379
      protocol: tcp
      name: redis
  misp-suricata-sync:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services: []
  thehive:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 9000
      protocol: tcp
      name: thehive-api
  thehive-cassandra:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 9042
      protocol: tcp
      name: cassandra
  thehive-es:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 9200
      protocol: tcp
      name: elasticsearch
  cortex:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 9001
      protocol: tcp
      name: cortex-api
  shuffle-backend:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 5001
      protocol: tcp
      name: shuffle-api
  shuffle-frontend:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 443
      protocol: tcp
      name: https
    - port: 80
      protocol: tcp
      name: http
  shuffle-orborus:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services: []
  shuffle-opensearch:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 9200
      protocol: tcp
      name: opensearch-rest
    - port: 9300
      protocol: tcp
      name: opensearch-transport
  wazuh-sidecar-db:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services: []
  wazuh-sidecar-suricata:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services: []
  webapp:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 8080
      protocol: tcp
      name: http
  ad:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 389
      protocol: tcp
      name: ldap
    - port: 88
      protocol: tcp
      name: kerberos
    - port: 445
      protocol: tcp
      name: smb
  db:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 5432
      protocol: tcp
      name: postgres
  workstation:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 22
      protocol: tcp
      name: ssh
  fileshare:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 445
      protocol: tcp
      name: smb
  dns:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 53
      protocol: udp
      name: dns
  victim:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 22
      protocol: tcp
      name: ssh
  kali:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 22
      protocol: tcp
      name: ssh
  kali-capture:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services: []
  aptl-otel-collector:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 4317
      protocol: tcp
      name: otlp-grpc
    - port: 4318
      protocol: tcp
      name: otlp-http
  aptl-tempo:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 3200
      protocol: tcp
      name: tempo-http
  aptl-grafana-otel:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 3000
      protocol: tcp
      name: grafana
infrastructure:
  security-net:
    properties:
      cidr: 172.20.0.0/24
      gateway: 172.20.0.1
      internal: false
  dmz-net:
    properties:
      cidr: 172.20.1.0/24
      gateway: 172.20.1.1
      internal: true
  internal-net:
    properties:
      cidr: 172.20.2.0/24
      gateway: 172.20.2.1
      internal: true
  redteam-net:
    properties:
      cidr: 172.20.4.0/24
      gateway: 172.20.4.1
      internal: true
  wazuh-manager:
    links:
    - security-net
    - dmz-net
    - internal-net
  wazuh-indexer:
    links:
    - security-net
    dependencies:
    - wazuh-manager
  wazuh-dashboard:
    links:
    - security-net
    dependencies:
    - wazuh-indexer
    - wazuh-manager
  suricata:
    links:
    - security-net
    - dmz-net
    - internal-net
  misp:
    links:
    - security-net
    dependencies:
    - misp-db
    - misp-redis
  misp-db:
    links:
    - security-net
  misp-redis:
    links:
    - security-net
  misp-suricata-sync:
    links:
    - security-net
    dependencies:
    - misp
    - suricata
  thehive:
    links:
    - security-net
    dependencies:
    - thehive-cassandra
    - thehive-es
    - cortex
  thehive-cassandra:
    links:
    - security-net
  thehive-es:
    links:
    - security-net
  cortex:
    links:
    - security-net
    dependencies:
    - thehive-es
  shuffle-backend:
    links:
    - security-net
    dependencies:
    - shuffle-opensearch
  shuffle-frontend:
    links:
    - security-net
    dependencies:
    - shuffle-backend
  shuffle-orborus:
    links:
    - security-net
    dependencies:
    - shuffle-backend
  shuffle-opensearch:
    links:
    - security-net
  wazuh-sidecar-db:
    links:
    - security-net
    dependencies:
    - wazuh-manager
    - db
  wazuh-sidecar-suricata:
    links:
    - security-net
    dependencies:
    - wazuh-manager
    - suricata
  webapp:
    links:
    - dmz-net
    - internal-net
    dependencies:
    - db
    - wazuh-manager
  ad:
    links:
    - internal-net
    dependencies:
    - wazuh-manager
  db:
    links:
    - internal-net
  workstation:
    links:
    - internal-net
    dependencies:
    - wazuh-manager
  fileshare:
    links:
    - internal-net
    dependencies:
    - wazuh-manager
  dns:
    links:
    - security-net
    - dmz-net
    - internal-net
    dependencies:
    - wazuh-manager
  victim:
    links:
    - internal-net
    dependencies:
    - wazuh-manager
  kali:
    links:
    - redteam-net
    - dmz-net
    - internal-net
  kali-capture:
    dependencies:
    - kali
  aptl-otel-collector:
    links:
    - security-net
  aptl-tempo:
    links:
    - security-net
  aptl-grafana-otel:
    links:
    - security-net
    dependencies:
    - aptl-tempo
features:
  techvault-webapp-service:
    type: service
    source:
      name: aptl-webapp
      version: local
    description: TechVault vulnerable customer portal service.
  techvault-defensive-stack:
    type: service
    source:
      name: aptl-soc-stack
      version: local
    description: Wazuh, Suricata, MISP, TheHive, Cortex, and Shuffle services.
conditions:
  wazuh-manager-health:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-wazuh-manager
    interval: 30
    description: Declarative healthcheck required before public startup is ready.
